title: Quinnen Williams’ clear Cowboys wish may have just gotten pricier with Dallas brass eager to start contract talks

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Quinnen Williams’ clear Cowboys wish may have just gotten pricier with Dallas brass eager to start contract talks
sources.description: The former Jet, acquired by Dallas through a trade in 2025, still has two years left on a four-year, $96 million deal, but "he's at the top" of Jerry Jones' contract talk list.
